name: Loops Overnight Gameplan
prompt:
Historical training integration approved September 23, 2026: Starting with fresh full runs, use the documented --archive-history option in ml.overnight_runtime. The user explicitly authorized incorporating all configured stocks' verified XNAS.ITCH daily, hourly, minute and second archives, including older 2018/2019 history where present. Follow the Historical training integration section of docs/loops-system-analysis/NIGHTLY_GAMEPLAN.md. Keep the existing 21:05 America/Los_Angeles start; target completion by 03:30 Pacific with the original next-exchange-session 04:00 hard deadline. Use all eligible verified historical samples; do not extend runtime just to consume the window or relax model criteria. The native stock_target_history stage now acquires only missing minute prefixes matching observed feature history, with fresh exact zero-dollar, provider-range, finite record-count and bounded-capacity checks. Current review identifies AAPL/AMZN/COST/GOOG/MU/NVDA prefixes from 2019-08-19 to 2025-01-13; recompute the native manifest at runtime and reuse verified prefixes, never assume this list is permanent. Preserve current production cursors. No new license, cross-dataset price blending, invented target prices or synthetic training rows. The new archive feature contract uses completed daily history plus causal hourly/optional inputs, explicit warmup/split/quality exclusions, and exact minute target windows. Second-level history contributes source-consistency verification without duplicating training examples. Verify the manifest-bound archive-history.json, source files, per-symbol date ranges, per-horizon cohort sizes, exclusions and seconds/minutes consistency alongside all existing final checks. Broader history does not guarantee a model passes Brier/log-loss assessment; preserve honest quality statuses. Resume inherits the saved archive-history policy, source and deadline: never add the new flag to an older failed attempt or rerun a completed source session. Preserve manual trader selection and all trading controls; this change only prepares future nightly publications.

Research onboarding completion and recovery contract (September 14, 2026): Use docs/loops-system-analysis/RESEARCH_SYMBOL_ONBOARDING.md and the current production watchlist. The CROX/PATH/TWST/IONQ batch has its own activation.json; trust verified ACTIVE membership, never an earlier seven-symbol assumption. The reusable workflow now finishes with `research_onboarding finalize --plan ...` after a completed native attempt; it verifies candidate references and all stages, locks the handoff, validates, then activates. Preserve saved production-baseline.json and candidate artifacts; failed onboarding restores only references proven to belong to that batch and refuses an independently advanced publication. Ownership preparation may append freshly observed new-symbol holdings through the existing native ledger with zero execution budgets, matching-account/no-working-order/no-reservation/no-block checks, and no allocation or order creation. A source-verified price path may explicitly report UNAVAILABLE_REFERENCE_PRICE or UNAVAILABLE_MINIMUM_SAMPLES; the informational trade plan then records UNAVAILABLE_PRICE_REFERENCES and omits chronological trades, ending cash and ending holdings. Do not manufacture prices or weaken quote, source, ownership, model or live execution checks. These explicit availability states supersede older instructions requiring numeric estimates for every planning clock.

Today-only exceptions: The user explicitly authorized finishing the already frozen September 14 candidate after 04:00 and manually starting late opening entries before 05:00 Pacific. The source-bound deadline-exception.json expires at 05:00 September 14; it permits only the planning/actuals tail and verified activation, never training new intraday forecasts or submitting orders. The manual Gameplan session can be started by the user with `--late-opening-date 2026-09-14`; recognize this exact optional date and the matching launcher/child identity. It expires at 05:00, retains original forecast identities/target ends and the existing persistent hourly entry-slot claim. Do not replay a consumed slot, start the trader, add this flag to recurring launch commands, or extend these exceptions to another date. All later sessions retain ordinary 04:00 opening preparation and 04:01 entry timing.

Research onboarding approved September 13, 2026: CROX, PATH, TWST and IONQ are explicitly selected from the September 13 Sunday report for the reusable batch workflow in docs/loops-system-analysis/RESEARCH_SYMBOL_ONBOARDING.md. Inspect C:/DATASTORE/state/research-onboarding and the registered plan's progress only when an authorized unfinished batch exists. The current plan is C:/dev/ducketz/artifacts/analysis/research-onboarding-20260913/plan.json. Preserve its candidate watchlist while production membership remains unchanged. A healthy owner may be preparing provider batches or downloading history before a native overnight run exists; honor its supervision lease and process locks. Do not start a competing daily pipeline. If that owner is gone, acquire your own supervision UUID and follow the documented resumable fetch/train/validate/activate path, diagnosing failures before resuming. This explicitly authorized candidate preparation may run on the weekend even when the prior seven-symbol Gameplan is complete. Preserve any native attempt's original next-session 04:00 Pacific deadline and resume only its failed stage. Require the 2018 history floor, fresh zero-dollar Databento cost checks, bounded capacity, complete source receipts and fresh candidate validation before atomic activation. Reuse shared CME and macro history. This authorization covers onboarding these selected companies and completing registered operator-authorized batches; it does not authorize selecting or activating future research companies without the user's instruction. Onboarding never starts a trader or changes trading controls, risk limits, options mode or the adaptation-development pause. Once a batch is ACTIVE, normal configured-universe operations handle it; do not repeat its full history download or training.

Bounded planning-reference completion approved September 10, 2026: apply the native cash-aware-gameplan-trade-planning-v4 policy automatically for rare trailing gaps in the current action date's exact previous XNYS session. When the last actual close is more than five but at most fifteen minutes before 17:00 Pacific, and a verified native source partition completely covers the interval through that boundary, carry that price forward into explicitly synthetic one-minute OHLC bars with zero assumed volume. This supersedes earlier planning-only prohibitions on short-gap carry-forward and does not require successful Historical and Live comparisons. Treat the absence as ASSUMED_NO_TRADES, not proven absence of trading; preserve the original observed timestamp and separate effective boundary. Keep the five-minute rule for actual historical samples, training labels, actuals, and independent quote freshness. Never fill across sessions, overwrite native data, borrow another symbol or dataset, hide invalid/incomplete downloads, or exceed fifteen minutes. Verify manifest-bound planning-reference-completion.json and synthetic-reference-bars.parquet, v2 price-band/path derivations, all hourly price points, and unchanged original observations. The readable review must disclose each synthetic anchor. Resume only the failed planning/actuals tail after a verified repair, keeping the pinned forecasts and original deadline.

Manual-start Gameplan behavior approved September 9, 2026: the user starts C:/dev/ducketz/Start-Gameplan-Trader.cmd once. That manual action enables the existing stock controls and selects gameplan-direction-current-market-v1 with --wait-for-open --execute. Do not require another click, confirmation or approval at 04:00. Before the next supported 04:00 Pacific opening, the same bounded worker reports SLEEPING_UNTIL_OPEN, action_date, wakes_at and a fresh heartbeat. It holds the session lock, checks local controls, and performs no broker/order, model-readiness, inventory or entry-slot work while asleep. At wake it reads the current Gameplan and continues automatically; the first normal entry batch is 04:01, and the existing 13:06 transition and 16:59 closing-exit timing remain.

Treat a matching waiting worker as intentional and healthy, not a failed early start. Recognize the exact optional --wait-for-open flag and the selected Gameplan sizing policy in both virtualenv launcher/child commands. Preserve that operator-selected mode and the same session owner. The existing Windows 03:55 launcher can adopt an already-running manual worker instead of launching a duplicate. Its saved default fixed-policy command and schedule remain unchanged when no manual worker exists. Do not activate or start the manual live trader on the user's behalf; the user performs that single initial start.

Under this explicitly selected Gameplan policy, promoted >=54% bullish forecasts buy using full horizon allocation and actual current cash; <=46% bearish forecasts sell available held shares, with neutral zero. Runtime decisions use current ask for buys and current bid for sales, rounded to cents. The Gameplan price/cash ranges are estimates only: being outside them never blocks, skips, caps, reprices or authorizes an order. Actual cash, actual holdings, pending orders and actual broker fills govern quantities. No projected sale proceeds become spendable cash. Current source/session/ownership and reliable order identity checks still apply.

The new policy can explicitly record snapshot-bound assignment of unallocated existing stock for a directional sale, without inventing BUY fills or taking another horizon's shares. Actual broker evidence reduces inventory; rejected or cancelled unfilled assigned shares return to unallocated stock with recorded release evidence. Preserve these records, unknown submissions and existing owned holdings. The legacy fixed policy remains separate. Use the updated NIGHTLY_GAMEPLAN.md and INDEPENDENT_STOCK_HORIZONS.md as the current implementation contract; this explicit manual-mode behavior supersedes older statements that all stock execution must be fixed-policy long-only or that starts before 03:55 must fail.

Existing scheduled default and other operating procedures follow. Apply their fixed-policy-only statements to the legacy fixed worker; preserve the explicitly selected manual Gameplan mode described above.

Run the Ducketz post-close Gameplan workflow in C:\dev\ducketz as a standalone Scheduled task. Read docs\loops-system-analysis\NIGHTLY_GAMEPLAN.md completely first; it is the operating procedure for active supervision, repair, controlled stop, recovery, resume, and final verification. Inspect the current overnight status and existing Scheduled tasks before starting so there is only one owner. If an eligible completed session requires a fresh run, start .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -u -m ml.overnight_runtime --datastore-target pc --once --scheduled --stock-only --independent-stock-horizons --stock-price-source xnas-itch-archive-v1 --archive-history. If that source session already has unfinished work, follow the adoption/resume rules below instead. This command fetches/appends the completed session, builds Directional data/models, evaluates all saved Gameplans from September 4, trains the four stock target groups and publishes the next session's independent-stock-targets-v1 Gameplan without waiting for optional Strategy training or generation. Stay with the running process and inspect status, new logs, and health history at least once a minute; do not end after launching it or wait until final completion to read errors. Investigate reported errors immediately. Healthy training may take hours and may continue over a weekend until 04:00 Pacific on the next exchange session. Do not mistake quiet CPU-active training for a stall. Make focused non-trading repairs backed by evidence and relevant tests, record the repair in operator-notes.md, and use the documented controlled stop/recovery and --resume-run procedure when a restart is necessary. Resume only the failed stage and retain the original deadline; do not blindly retry an unchanged failure. Preserve concurrent edits, raw data, immutable published Gameplans, model assessment gates, and all trading controls/code. Never place, cancel, or replace orders, run an old recurring stack, delete lock files, or start a second pipeline. Honor holiday no-op receipts. Verify the final report/receipt/logs, expected next-session date, exactly 24 forecasts and 24 intents per configured symbol (264 of each for eleven symbols), cumulative evaluation coverage, provider coverage, model status, and zero overnight orders. Report exact unresolved failures, missing data, or research-only groups with evidence paths. Before starting, adopting, stopping, repairing, or resuming any work, generate one new UUID for this Scheduled task and acquire the supervision claim with python -m ml.overnight_runtime --datastore-target pc --claim-supervision <your-uuid>, using the repository .venv Python. Proceed only on ACQUIRED. Reuse your UUID to renew at least once a minute while monitoring or repairing; if BUSY, another task owns the run, so make no changes and end this wake. Never reuse another task's UUID. Release your claim with --release-supervision <your-uuid> when finished. The three-minute expiry lets the watch adopt an abandoned task without two operators repairing concurrently.

Symbol-universe integration: Read the production universe from C:/dev/ducketz/datafetching/watchlist.txt. Explicitly selected companies from the Sunday research report use docs/loops-system-analysis/RESEARCH_SYMBOL_ONBOARDING.md and become active only after its verified batch activation. For N configured symbols, current Gameplans require 24 x N forecasts, 24 x N options-intent rows and 3 x N production OPRA symbol/schema cursors; eleven symbols means 264, 264 and 33. Validate every immutable historical run against its own saved universe. Evaluate a company only in saved plans that actually contain it; pre-onboarding absence is not missing market data. Keep current stock-only preparation, separate 1h/4h/1d/1w contracts and all model and trading gates.

The accepted stock-only design is documented in INDEPENDENT_STOCK_HORIZONS.md: 13 hourly entry forecasts, four forward four-hour forecasts including 16:00 through next exchange session 07:00, one extended 04:00 to 17:00 daily entry and one first-04:00 to fifth-session-17:00 weekly entry per symbol. The remaining five rows per symbol are explicitly non-entry research/outlooks. Keep the native five-minute price-observation tolerance, exact symbol-and-route fitted-history checks, chronological partitions, minimum sample counts and model promotion gates. Unsupported symbol/horizon histories remain RESEARCH_NO_TARGET_HISTORY. Options remain separate research; stock-only intents are NO_TRADE_STOCK_ONLY. Directional publication and independent sizing qualification are separate checks. Never relabel models or train/retry without new justified evidence.

Independent stock training is now part of the native pipeline. For the explicit xnas-itch-archive-v1 source, stock_target_history maintains only the configured stocks' verified XNAS.ITCH OHLCV1m archive before evaluation; each exact request must pass the included zero-dollar cost and capacity checks. No cross-dataset price blending or missing-price substitution is allowed. After Gameplan publication, stock_enrichment_training fits and assesses separate horizon sizing models from the four immutable, manifest-bound training-cohort parquets. The final receipt must include that stage unless the owner explicitly requested a narrower boundary. Check fitted versus qualified statuses separately, preserve the exact price source on resume, and retain the original deadline and all quality gates. Existing publications keep their own source identity and outcomes.

Daily schedule and ownership: Wake at 21:05 (9:05 p.m.) America/Los_Angeles, following Pacific daylight/standard time. This is the start of the entire daily Loop A fetch and its existing downstream workflow, including all configured Databento, FMP, FRED, Schwab and SEC scopes, production OPRA maintenance, Directional training, XNAS target history, cumulative evaluation, final Gameplan training/publication and enrichment. XNAS.ITCH unlicensed Historical is normally released at the next Eastern midnight, which is 21:00 Pacific; 21:05 provides a five-minute margin, not proof of availability. Inspect the actual required provider/schema ranges and exact zero-dollar acquisition preflights; preserve coverage gates if a provider is late. On weekends or exchange holidays honor native calendar no-ops; do not invent another completed session. Before starting a fresh pipeline, inspect whether the eligible source session already has a completed publication or an unfinished attempt. Do not rerun completed work. Adopt a healthy owner only under the supervision claim procedure; when new availability or a verified repair resolves a failure, resume the existing failed attempt, preserving successful upstream stages, exact configuration and the original next-session 04:00 Pacific deadline. Do not retry the previously confirmed XNAS Live license denial or acquire a new license. The Operations Watch is the recovery supervisor; it must not start a missing fresh daily pipeline before 21:15 Pacific.

Revised Gameplan process approved September 8, 2026: the normal 21:05 Pacific full independent-stock workflow must run gameplan_publication, stock_enrichment_training and gameplan_trade_planning after the existing data/history/evaluation stages. The daily directional model now compares the fixed regularized-logistic C grid 0.001, 0.01, 0.1 and 1 using development data; assessment results never select candidates. New independent directional publications use the explicit v2 operating criteria: Brier score no more than baseline plus 0.005 and log loss no more than baseline plus 0.01, with recorded actual scores, retained probability variation, calibration and sample checks. Qualification under this user-approved rule does not claim baseline outperformance. Read each publication's own policy; historical strict-policy reports keep their original status. If a new model still fails the configured criteria, investigate its data, fitting and development selection, implement a justified tested improvement and rerun the affected stage before the original deadline. Do not end with only a diagnosis when a concrete repair remains available, and do not manufacture a pass or repeatedly select models using assessment outcomes.

The stock direction thresholds are bullish at 54% P(up) or above and bearish at 46% or below, with neutral between them. Model approval remains separate. Daily labels count the completed source session as Day 1 and the next exchange session as Day 2; preserve actual dates and frozen IDs.

The required gameplan_trade_planning tail now includes the user-approved chronological cash and share process. Retain the same pinned Gameplan and original next-session 04:00 deadline. Each stock's table must show Projected Trade Quantity immediately followed by Direction Based Trade Qty, the working Trade Price range, Cash available after (range), Shares remaining and Plan action. Projected Trade Quantity is each opportunity's independent affordable full horizon capacity; Direction Based Trade Qty is the source of the sequential cash/share projection. Bullish buys use available cash; bearish sells use available held stock; neutral has zero direction quantity. Non-entry outlooks show a dash.

Use one shared account cash ledger across all symbols and clocks, with separate symbol/horizon lots. At each hour apply bearish sales, remaining due horizon exits, then bullish purchases. Resolve competing unallocated-stock sales by shorter horizon then symbol; order buys by highest published probability, then shorter horizon and symbol. Never spend the same cash or sell the same share twice. Respect existing pending reservations and protect other horizons' held lots. Buy sizes use whole shares at the working range's upper price, the full horizon allocation, conservative remaining cash and remaining investment/exposure capacity. This planning scenario does not apply the separate live worker's confidence multiplier or six-order batch limit. Preserve the configured initial cash buffer.

Cash starts from a fresh read-only snapshot's literal available cash after pending reservations. Buys subtract upper/mid/lower costs from low/base/high cash; sales add lower/mid/upper proceeds and remove shares. Every forecast row at the same clock shows the post-entire-hour balance. Include an hourly portfolio table, an ordered event ledger with before/change/after balances, and end-of-day cash and shares. Record expiry exits separately even when that clock's direction is neutral. Retain positions expiring after this session. Totals are conditional on the planned fills, before fees and taxes; actual missing fills or unavailable sale proceeds require recalculation. Preserve the no-fill baseline.

Build one reusable price path from the existing observed price archive, using one fixed observation timestamp. The working price center is the observed historical median close-to-clock ratio applied to the latest observed prior close, with a configurable default +/-20 basis-point fill allowance and outward cent rounding. These tight ranges are conditional fill assumptions, not learned confidence intervals or guaranteed prices. Preserve broader historical 5th/95th percentile ranges separately. Use all available observed pairs in the 120-session window; the removed 30-sample requirement must not block a range when two or more observed pairs are available. Keep sample counts, source verification and execution-preview diagnostics out of the main tables. Do not add 'reference only' labels.

Verify the complete native overnight receipt and separate trade-plan current pointer, matching source and action date, 24 augmented rows per configured symbol, fresh cash and holdings, actual price observation times, all required hourly price points, and cash/share conservation across every event and summary. Save the source-bound direction-ledger.json and planning-price-path.json with the publication and expose the readable Gameplan path. Resume a failed tail without retraining successful upstream stages or changing the original deadline; preserve narrower stage orders in old attempts.

This process is automatic inside the existing nightly tail, not a duplicate schedule. It creates a planning scenario and never submits orders or assigns real manual holdings to horizon allocations. Keep the daytime worker's existing execution process separate: its current scheduled-entry preview remains in expandable review details and its live account/quote/ownership checks still apply. A modeled bearish sale is not evidence that the current long-only worker will execute that sale.

Completed-session actuals review approved September 9, 2026: after tomorrow's gameplan_publication, stock_enrichment_training and gameplan_trade_planning finish, the normal full independent-stock pipeline must run its new final gameplan_actuals_review stage. Do not launch a duplicate schedule or move this results review ahead of successor preparation. The native stage receives the same pinned successor Gameplan and original next-session 04:00 Pacific deadline. It compares the last verified prior-session Gameplan and matching trade plan saved before that session's 04:00 opening with observed stock prices from the existing nightly fetch, using the original source dataset and five-minute boundary rules. Verify the saved price range and midpoint, same-clock actual prices and timestamps, dollar/percentage differences and in-range results, plus all frozen forecast rows with actual start/end prices, raw price move and directional outcome. Neutral, future and missing outcomes are excluded from direction accuracy; retain cost-adjusted model scores separately. Never rebuild past estimates, alter the frozen Gameplan or treat market observations as actual broker fills or realized P/L. The separate immutable output is ml/gameplan-actuals-review-runs/<generation>/Gameplan-results.md, with forecast-results.parquet, price-results.parquet, report.json, a verified manifest and receipt. Check ml/gameplan-actuals-review-latest/run.json and the dated ml/gameplan-actuals-review-by-date/<prior-action-date>/Gameplan-results.md linked from tomorrow's Gameplan. Report explicit pending/missing coverage. A failed actuals review resumes only that stage with the same successor and deadline, preserving successful preparation. Older or explicitly narrower recorded stage orders retain their original endpoint. Read the updated NIGHTLY_GAMEPLAN.md for the full contract.
